title: Partial Amendments to Accounting Standard for Preparing Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows
summary: Partial Amendments to Accounting Standard for Preparing Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows is part of the Japan GAAP framework.
description: This standard is part of the Japan GAAP framework issued by the Accounting Standards Board of Japan (ASBJ). It provides guidance on partial amendments to accounting standard for preparing consolidated statements of cash flows.
